question.text: Fund ABC has an NAV of Rs. 50 crore. What is the MAXIMUM total exposure (long + short after permitted offsetting) the fund can take?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per pages 124-125 of the workbook, leverage is defined as Total Exposure (Long + Short after permitted offsetting) divided by NAV and is capped at 2x NAV. For Fund ABC with NAV of Rs. 50 crore, total exposure shall not exceed 2 x 50 = Rs. 100 crore. The Trap: Rs. 50 crore equals 1x (no leverage); Rs. 150 crore is 3x and exceeds the cap. Note: The workbook uses NAV as the denominator for this leverage computation.
